positions.source_passage:
But here's the real point. AI will make far fewer mistakes than humans. Far fewer. Perhaps none at all? Then no one will have to hold anybody to blame.

How about that?

Give AI room to breathe and let market forces reign it in.
positions.position_gist: Urges FDA to impose minimal regulatory burden on AI-enabled devices, asserting AI will make far fewer errors than humans and that market forces (and liability exposure) rather than added regulatory evidence requirements should constrain it.
